$source: Built by hand from the OpenAPI schema named in "schema" (twilio-oai, spec/json/twilio_pricing_v1.json, commit 141f1201b55abcc16b3aa8089e71c4a927326975, unchanged on main at 2026-10-15) and cross-checked with twilio@6.1.2. Not captured from any account: every SID is made up and every number is a 555 example.
schema: pricing.v1.phone_number.phone_number_country-instance (FetchPhoneNumberCountry). Prices are strings, per the x-twilio overrideType and the docs example; these amounts are made up and are not real prices.
